reviews.title: One Good Game
reviews.text: This game is really fun and really easy to learn how to play. If you are bored and you have nothing to do just download this brain game. Speaking of brain games, this game helps you understand and figure out puzzles lots of other things. Plus another upside to it is that it’s easy and free to get. Download this game now.

reviews.title: Pretty good
reviews.text: I love these types of games, however there’s too many math questions for my personal taste. That being said, so far I’ve found 2 mistakes they’ve made in their math (their “correct” answers were actually wrong). The translations are also kinda rough but it doesn’t take away from gameplay at all. It’s fun to play and I plan to finish it :)

reviews.title: Pop up add on bottom of game screen
reviews.text: I have gotten to level 81 on the game but every time I would try to press the hit button an add at the bottom of the screen would get in the way. The game is really fun for me but the pop up adds have gotten to annoying for me to continue playing this game.
